title: Kostka staje na 20
description: Ekstremalne zbliżenie podłogi. K20 zwalnia, zatrzymuje się polem 20 prosto do kamery; po krótkim czytelnym zatrzymaniu cyfra 20 i artefakt rozbłyskują. Bez portalu w tym ujęciu.

prompts.image: Exact edit of revision 1: preserve the 20 activation macro and reduce only the K20 to canonical 3.0 cm vertex-to-vertex, about 2.5 cm face-to-face. It reads as a small tabletop die relative to grout, stool and bed, while macro framing keeps the exact 20 legible and glow important.
prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second macro shot. The small canonical 3 cm K20 makes its final wobble, settles with 20 toward camera, then its emerald core brightens in a controlled pulse and reflections spread across the tile.
